_description: Published calibration targets (Table I / Table II of the manuscript) and the ORIGINAL fit that reproduced them at the placeholder L=20cm. These are the numbers any new fit at L=72.2cm must reproduce.

table_I_original_L20cm._note: compliance C_total fixed at 4e-5 cm^5/dyn for all points; original fit achieved PI within 0.02 and RI within 0.03 of target at every point

table_II_original_L20cm._note: 3-parameter fit (Rtotal, dp_inlet, p0) against 3 targets (PI, RI, absolute UV flow = 2*mean(q_outlet)*60). UV flow target source: Ozawa et al. 2023, Table 2, 50th percentile.

growth_curve_r0._description: PCHIP interpolation, UA mean-of-two-arteries diameter (mm) vs GA (weeks); r0_cm = diameter_mm / 2 / 10. Valid anchored range 12-30 weeks; GA=11,33,37 are extrapolations.

fixed_params.L_NEW_TARGET_source: this specimen's own reconstructed UA trunk arc length (manuscript Section II-C): real digitized cord centreline (617.8mm) run through the coiling-index helix-length relationship sqrt(1+(2*pi*r/pitch)^2) with r=4.82mm, pitch=50mm/turn -> 722mm trunk, excluding the 170mm placental branch tree which the single non-branching 1D solver does not represent
